recruiterCard.summary: A job platform that implements durable at-least-once execution directly on PostgreSQL: transactional outbox, worker leases, fencing, retries, and crash recovery.
impactBullets: Engineered crash-safe, at-least-once job processing with a PostgreSQL state machine, transactional outbox, idempotent submission, leases, heartbeats, and stale-attempt fencing.
Added retries with bounded exponential backoff, cancellation over heartbeats, timeouts, and a replayable dead-letter queue.
Wrote 1,000+ Go tests; a recorded local benchmark completed 10,000 of 10,000 jobs through 24 injected worker kills.
The tuned profile reached 209 ms p95 dispatch and 11 s worst recovery; shipped defaults measured 964 ms and 50 s (records in the repo).
